info.name: Gymora API
info.description:
# Gymora API Postman Collection

## Overview

Complete Postman collection for the Gymora ASP.NET Core 9.0 REST API.

## Authentication

This API uses **JWT Bearer Token** authentication.

1. Call `POST /api/Auth/login` with valid credentials.
2. The `accessToken` and `refreshToken` are automatically saved as collection variables.
3. All protected endpoints automatically include the `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header.

## Rate Limiting

| Policy | Limit | Window | Endpoints |
|--------|-------|--------|-----------|
| `login` | 5 requests | 1 minute | POST /api/Auth/login |
| `otp-sensitive` | 3 requests | 5 minutes | POST resend-confirmation-email, POST forgot-password |
| `otp-verify` | 10 requests | 1 minute | POST verify-otp, POST reset-password, GET confirm-email |

## Error Response Format

```json
{
  "isSuccess": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable error message"
  }
}
```

### Error Codes

| Status | Code | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | Invalid input / validation failure |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Model state validation failed |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid authentication |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Insufficient role/permission |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Resource not found |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many requests |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Unexpected server error |

## Success Response Format

```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Roles

| Role | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Owner | 0 | Full system access |
| Admin | 1 | Administrative access |
| User | 2 | Standard authenticated user |
| Guest | 3 | Limited guest access |
| Marchant | 4 | Merchant role |
| Parent | 5 | Parent role |

## Collection Variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL |
| `accessToken` | JWT access token (auto-saved on login) |
| `refreshToken` | Refresh token (auto-saved on login) |
| `currentUserId` | ID of the currently authenticated user |
| `createdEntityId` | ID of the last created Topic |

---

## Workflow: Authentication Flow

1. `Register` - Create a new user account
2. `Login` - Authenticate (saves tokens automatically)
3. `Get User Profile` - View profile
4. `Change Password` - Update password
5. `Refresh Token` - Get new tokens
6. `Logout` - Invalidate tokens

## Workflow: Password Reset Flow

1. `Forgot Password` - Request OTP
2. `Verify OTP` - Verify the OTP
3. `Reset Password` - Set new password

## Workflow: Topics CRUD

1. `Create Topic` - Create a new topic (requires User/Admin/Owner)
2. `Get Topics (Paged)` - List topics with pagination
3. `Get Topic by ID` - Get single topic
4. `Update Topic` - Modify a topic
5. `Delete Topic` - Remove a topic (requires Admin/Owner)

item.name: 01 Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints including registration, login, email confirmation, password management, and profile operations.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

After registration, a confirmation OTP is sent to the provided email address. The user must confirm their email before they can log in (depending on the application logic).

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `email` | Required, valid email format |
| `userName` | Required, 3-100 characters |
| `password` | Required, 8-100 characters. Must contain: uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character |
| `phoneNumber` | Optional, max 50 characters |

### Rate Limiting

This endpoint does NOT have rate limiting.

Confirm email address using the OTP code sent during registration.

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `email` | Required, valid email format |
| `otp` | Required, exactly 5 digits |

Resend the email confirmation OTP.

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `email` | Required, valid email format |

### Rate Limiting

This endpoint uses `otp-sensitive` policy: **3 requests per 5 minutes** per IP.

request.description:
Authenticate with email and password.

On success, the **accessToken** and **refreshToken** are automatically saved as collection variables. All subsequent requests will use these tokens.

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `email` | Required |
| `password` | Required |

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | number | User ID |
| `email` | string | User email |
| `personName` | string | Display name |
| `token` | string | JWT access token |
| `expiresIn` | number | Token expiration in seconds |
| `refreshtoken` | string | Refresh token |
| `roles` | string[] | Assigned roles |
| `refreshTokenExpirationDate` | string | Refresh token expiry (ISO-8601) |

### Rate Limiting

This endpoint uses `login` policy: **5 requests per 1 minute** per IP.

request.description:
Refresh an expired JWT access token using a valid refresh token.

Both the current `accessToken` (expired or valid) and `refreshToken` must be provided. On success, new tokens are automatically saved.

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `refreshToken` | Required |
| `accessToken` | Required |

Logout and invalidate the refresh token.

- Set `logoutFromAllDevices` to `true` to invalidate ALL refresh tokens for the user.
- Set to `false` (or omit) to only invalidate the provided refresh token.

The `UserId` is automatically extracted from the JWT claims, so it does not need to be provided in the body.

## Request Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `refreshToken` | string | No | The refresh token to invalidate |
| `logoutFromAllDevices` | bool | No | Invalidate all tokens (default: false) |

### Requires Authentication: Yes

Request a password reset OTP sent to the provided email address.

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| `email` | Required, valid email format |

### Rate Limiting

This endpoint uses `otp-sensitive` policy: **3 requests per 5 minutes** per IP.

item.description: Topic management endpoints with full CRUD operations and pagination.

request.description:
Get a paginated list of topics with optional search, sorting, and filtering.

## Request Body Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `pageNumber` | int | 1 | Page number (1-based) |
| `pageSize` | int | 10 | Page size (max 50) |
| `searchTerm` | string | null | Search term (max 100 chars) |
| `orderBy` | string | "Id" | Property to order by |
| `orderDirection` | string | "asc" | Sort direction: "asc" or "desc" |
| `isActive` | bool | true | Filter by active status |
| `createdById` | int | null | Filter by creator |
| `filters` | object | null | Advanced filtering (BetweenFilters, ExactFilters) |

## Pagination Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `totalCount` | number | Total items matching the query |
| `pageSize` | number | Items per page |
| `pageNumber` | number | Current page |
| `totalPages` | number | Total number of pages |
| `hasPrevious` | boolean | Whether a previous page exists |
| `hasNext` | boolean | Whether a next page exists |
| `items` | array | Topic items for current page |

### Requires Roles: User, Admin, Owner, or Guest

item.name: 03 Negative Test Cases
item.description: Negative test scenarios to verify API error handling, validation, and authorization.

request.description:
Attempt to access a protected endpoint without providing a JWT token.

**Expected Result:** HTTP 401 Unauthorized

Attempt to delete a topic without having Admin or Owner role.

**Expected Result:** HTTP 403 Forbidden with `FORBIDDEN` error code.

**Note:** This test will only trigger 403 if the current user does NOT have Admin or Owner role. If the user has these roles, the request may return 404 (topic not found) instead.

Attempt to log in with invalid credentials.

**Expected Result:** HTTP 400 Bad Request with `BAD_REQUEST` error code.

Send a login request with an empty body (missing both email and password).

**Expected Result:** HTTP 400 Bad Request with `VALIDATION_ERROR` error code.

Attempt to get a topic that does not exist.

**Expected Result:** HTTP 404 Not Found with `NOT_FOUND` error code.

Attempt to refresh tokens with invalid values.

**Expected Result:** HTTP 400 Bad Request with `BAD_REQUEST` error code.
